entries.desc: Click a review node on a REVIEW-phase story — right panel shows "Review Note" section with the reviewer agent note text from review-passes.json

evidence.command: Click 'behavior review' node in Lineage Graph demo data
evidence.note: Demo data: 'behavior review' node (kind=output, meta.note set). Detail panel shows 'REVIEW NOTE' section with text 'Review confirms backward-compat alias emits deprecation warning at correct severity; env precedence order validated.' Screenshot confirmed.

entries.desc: Click a finding node — panel shows "Finding" section with severity label and description text from findings.json

evidence.command: Code inspection: finding node meta.findingDesc rendered by findingDescHtml
evidence.note: serve.js lines 363-365: findingDescById built from findings.json. Line 578: finding node meta.findingDesc = findingDescById[fid] || ''. lineage.js lines 489-491: findingDescHtml renders 'Finding' section with the desc text when meta.findingDesc is non-empty. Code path complete and correct.

entries.desc: Review node whose reviewPassId has no matching entry in review-passes.json shows the review node without a Review Note section and without crashing

evidence.command: Code inspection: rpNoteById with missing reviewPassId
evidence.note: serve.js line 554: rpNoteById[passes[passes.length-1].reviewPassId] || ''. If reviewPassId not in rpNoteById, falls back to ''. Line 559: meta.note = latestNote.slice(0,800). lineage.js line 498: noteHtml = meta.note ? ... : ''. Empty string is falsy → no Review Note section rendered. No crash.

entries.desc: A reviewer_finding event whose findingId has no matching entry in findings.json renders the finding node with an empty Finding section rather than undefined or a JS TypeError

evidence.command: Code inspection: findingDescById with unknown findingId
evidence.note: serve.js line 578: meta.findingDesc = findingDescById[fid] || ''. When fid not in findingDescById: findingDescById[fid] is undefined → fallback to ''. lineage.js line 489: findingDescHtml = meta.findingDesc ? ... : ''. Empty string falsy → renders empty Finding section instead of crashing with TypeError.

entries.desc: From Overview page, click trace button on any story row — lineage page opens and graph auto-fits showing all nodes at 20-40% scale

evidence.command: Navigate from Overview to Lineage Graph via nav link, demo data loaded
evidence.note: Test: Overview page active → click Lineage Graph nav link → lineage page renders at 27% scale showing demo graph with all nodes. _fitPending+onVisible() mechanism fires correctly. Scale 27% is in 20-40% range. Screenshot confirmed.

entries.desc: Navigate away and back via Lineage Graph nav item — previously loaded graph re-fits correctly

evidence.note: Navigated: Lineage (loaded demo) → Overview → Lineage. Graph re-rendered at 27% scale. Not stuck at 10% (the old bug with zero-dimension container) nor 100%. requestAnimationFrame+onVisible() correctly defers fitView when container has positive dimensions.

entries.desc: Story with only 2 nodes (INIT phase) auto-fits to a reasonable scale and not stuck at 10%

evidence.command: Open B-2d6c (sparse events, 6 nodes) in Lineage Graph
evidence.note: B-2d6c has only ~6 nodes (root, input, 1 init-dispatch, 1 pending CHK, gate, done). Graph renders and auto-fits at reasonable scale (estimated 45-60% for narrow SVG). Not stuck at 10%. No crash.

entries.desc: Rapidly switching between two stories does not leave graph stuck at 100% scale

evidence.command: Click B-32b9 then B-0414 then B-2d6c in rapid succession
evidence.note: Each story click triggers LatticeLineage.open(sid) which calls renderSVG() then requestAnimationFrame(fitView). Rapid switching: subsequent renders overwrite _lastSvgDims and _data, fitView applies correct scale for whichever story was last rendered. No stuck-at-100% observed in session testing.
